questions.question: What time does the cafe open?
How much money should be in the till at opening?
How many times do I run the backflush cycle?
questions.key_fact: Five times, 10 seconds on and 10 off

questions.question: What temperature should the milk fridge be?
questions.key_fact: 41 degrees F or below

questions.question: How do I void an item?
questions.key_fact: Select it and press Void before payment

questions.question: Do refunds over $20 need approval?
questions.key_fact: Yes, a manager's approval code

questions.question: Where is the ingredient binder?
questions.key_fact: Shelf under the register

questions.question: What time do we stop brewing batch coffee at night?
Where do I put the signed invoice?
questions.key_fact: The manager's tray

questions.question: What should I do if a customer has an allergic reaction?
questions.key_fact: Call 911 first

questions.question: How much coffee goes into the first test shot of the morning?
questions.key_fact: 18 grams in, 36 grams out, 25 to 30 seconds

questions.question: The machine that makes shots won't power up. What do I check?
questions.key_fact: The Espresso breaker and the water valve

questions.question: Can I use regular dish soap to clean the machine?
questions.key_fact: No, it foams and leaves residue

questions.question: A customer says her latte tastes off and wants a new one. What do I do?
questions.key_fact: Remake it free

questions.question: Someone wants their money back for a bag of beans they bought last week.
questions.key_fact: Unopened, within 14 days, with a receipt or a match

questions.question: A guy lost his receipt and doesn't remember his card number. Can I still give him his money back?
questions.key_fact: Search by date, time, and amount; if not found, offer a remake or drink card

questions.question: The truck brought fewer boxes of oat milk than we ordered. What do I do?
questions.key_fact: Note it on the invoice, driver initials, text the manager

questions.question: How do I make sure someone who can't have nuts gets a safe drink?
questions.key_fact: Allergy button, green-shelf pitcher, sealed syrups

questions.question: What do I do with the leftover croissants at the end of the day?
questions.key_fact: Log on the waste sheet and throw out

questions.question: Where do the dirty rags go when I'm done cleaning the machine?
questions.key_fact: Laundry bin in the back room

questions.question: Should I shut off the espresso machine before I leave for the night?
questions.key_fact: No, leave it on

questions.question: Where's the sheet where we write down stuff we throw away?
questions.key_fact: Clipboard behind the bar

questions.question: The dairy that just came in feels warm. Should I take it?
questions.key_fact: Reject anything above 41 degrees F

questions.question: The back door lock is broken and I'm trying to leave. What now?
questions.key_fact: Never leave it unlocked; call the manager and wait

questions.question: A customer complained about one of my coworkers and the boss isn't here.
questions.key_fact: Sealed envelope in the manager's tray; text the manager

questions.question: How long can milk sit warm before I have to dump it?
questions.key_fact: 4 hours above 41 degrees F

questions.question: The walk-in cooler feels warm. What should I do?
questions.key_fact: Check door and fan, recheck in 30 minutes, move dairy to the milk fridge

questions.question: The little fridge under the bar says 45 degrees at close. What do I do?
questions.key_fact: Check door and vent, recheck in 30 minutes, move milk to the walk-in
